steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize standard Android directory structure and set package name com.multiutilitysuite.app for Multi Utility Suite.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Setup app/build.gradle configured with AGP 8.3.2, compileSdkVersion 34, and Java 8 code compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml defining correct layout, platform requirements, and main launcher activity with system themes.

steps.title: Design Button Graphics
steps.description: Create background shape resources in drawables to styling UI buttons with soft teal/amber color highlights.

steps.title: Design Display Graphic
steps.description: Create calculator display panel background drawable with custom rounded corners and stroke properties.

steps.title: Design Main Layout XML
steps.description: Create layout_main.xml including bottom navigation views and separate layout modules for Calculator, Stopwatch, Notes, and Converter.

steps.title: Implement Navigation Controls
steps.description: Program standard bottom tab click listeners in MainActivity.java using pure standard Android SDK views.

steps.title: Code Calculator Functionality
steps.description: Implement complete responsive layout event handling for numbers, arithmetic operators, decimal values, and logic calculations.

steps.title: Code Stopwatch & Countdown Logic
steps.description: Implement Handler-based stopwatch counting with precision laps feature, plus standard Android CountDownTimer utility integration.

steps.title: Code Notepad Engine
steps.description: Design local SQLite-free persistence storage inside SharedPreferences to add, list, and delete custom text notes dynamically.

steps.title: Code Measurement Converter
steps.description: Implement math logic for Length, Weight, and Temperature spinner selections with dynamic unit conversion formulas.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Standard Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas, method references, or Java 9+ features are used inside MainActivity.java implementation.

steps.title: Building Multi Utility Suite
steps.description: Assemble final release APK using system Gradle configurations.
